cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: JengaCoder is an offline coding and engineering assistant designed to help students and developers build, debug, and understand software and embedded-system projects on affordable laptops without depending on cloud AI services.

test_prompts.prompt: Write a complete Python function called calculate_average that accepts a list of numbers. Return 0 for an empty list. Include two example calls.

I have an Arduino Uno, one HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor, one SG90 servo motor, and jumper wires. Create a simple automatic dustbin that opens when a person is within 40 cm. Give me the pin connections, complete Arduino code, and a short testing procedure. Do not use components I did not mention.
